title: Sunnyside Route 8 Load Verification
brief: A light-truck driver’s load verification record comparing a delivery against its shipping papers.

slip.document:
# Sunnyside Route 8 Load Verification
Daily delivery record

## Pickup details
Date: 06/18/2026
Driver: Hannah Ellison
Dispatcher: Keiko Quinn
Pickup location: Sunnyside Produce Cooperative, 418 Willow Bend Road, Fort Wayne, IN
Truck: Unit 27, 14-ft box truck
Shipping paper: SP-061826-44

## Shipping-paper inventory
| Item | Description | Paper quantity |
| --- | --- | ---: |
| A104 | Canned peaches, 12-can cases | 18 cases |
| B220 | Paper towel, 6-roll packs | 24 packs |
| C315 | Tomato sauce, 6-can cases | 10 cases |

## Physical count and disposition
At 6:42 AM, I counted the freight at the dock before closing the rear doors. Counts below are in the shipping paper's stated units.
- Physical count: 18 cases of A104 canned peaches.
- Physical count: 22 packs of B220 paper towels.
- Physical count: 10 cases of C315 tomato sauce.
- All quantities matched the shipping paper; no discrepancy was found.

Sunnyside's load-check procedure requires a recorded disposition for each shortage before departure. The shrink-wrapped freight was loaded in the order of the delivery stops, with C315 placed nearest the cab for the final stop. I checked the visible labels against the item codes on SP-061826-44 and confirmed the cases were dry, sealed, and free of crushed corners. The B220 packs were stacked on a separate pallet; two packs were short of the paper quantity, and I notified dispatcher Keiko Quinn by phone at 6:48 AM. Paul Moreau, the dock lead, witnessed the count and signed the pickup copy at 6:51 AM. I secured both load bars across the pallets and latched the rear doors before departure at 7:02 AM. The signed copy was placed in the cab document pouch for delivery reconciliation.

errors.quote: All quantities matched the shipping paper
errors.explanation: The shipping paper lists 24 packs of B220, but the physical count is 22 packs. The statement that all quantities matched contradicts those recorded counts.
errors.fix: Not all quantities matched the shipping paper

errors.quote: I notified dispatcher Keiko Quinn by phone at 6:48 AM.
errors.explanation: The document states that Sunnyside's procedure requires a recorded disposition for each shortage before departure, but this line records only notification. It does not say whether the shortage was authorized, held, or otherwise dispositioned before the truck left.
errors.fix: I notified dispatcher Keiko Quinn by phone at 6:48 AM and recorded her authorization to ship short two B220 packs.
